notes.title: Update #7
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32855148/a31a6cf6626354812d3a4832115fa5d901f19003.png


Improvements:

     Level Completed menu changed.
     Version Updates menu removed.
     Crouch Idle animation changed.
     Some changes on all levels.
     Improvements on materials.
     Songs credits removed.
     Gravity Boost removed.
     Speed Boost removed.
     Fuel System removed.
     Slow Motion removed.
     Credits removed.
     Extras removed.



Bug Fixes:

     Musics are not looping bug solved.



News:

     Double Jump added.



Optimization:

     Big optimizations at all levels.



Balance:

     Health Regeneration removed.
     Time limiting removed.



Announce:
In this big update, we focused at optimizations because of our dear players' feedbacks. So we optimized game and removed old stuffs like specials and more. For a easier game experience, we removed time limiting. There is a lot of new improvements too. Good games!
